entries.text: 道多艸，不可行。从艸弗聲。

出# protrude + 艸 grass/plant → protruding bud/sprout → *to bud*; *to sprout* → *flourishing vegetation*. 茁 was devised as a replacement character for 出 after 出 acquired its associated and extended meanings.
艸初生出地皃。从艸出聲。《詩》曰：“彼茁者葭。”
As per 戊# (cover) + 艸 grass/plant → thick vegetation covering a wide area → *thick growth* → *thrive*.
艸豐盛。从艸戊聲。

氾# overflow + 艸 grass/plant → *thick grass*; name of a particular variety of *grass*. * Bee* may owe to a symbiotic relation between a particular variety of grass and bees. *Rule* and *regulation* are borrowed meanings.
艸也。从艸氾聲。
As per 加# (place atop) + 艸 grass/plant → lotus stem, atop of which rests a multi-layered flower. *Eggplant* (茄子) is a borrowed meaning.
芙蕖莖。从艸加聲。
矛# pike/halberd (→ shape indicator) + 艸 grass/plant → (pike-shaped) *miscanthus* (compare 茆 and 萱) → *rushes*; *grass*. Also, *thatched roof* (← thatch with miscanthus reeds or rushes) → *house*.
菅也。从艸矛聲。
Effectively a variant form of 茅 *miscanthus*, with 卯# replacing 矛. Also, a variety of *waterplant*.

As per 犮# (split away) + 艸 grass/plant → split grass or vegetation off to both sides (compare 蔽) → *split grass off to both sides*. Also, via a separate application of the combination of the constituent elements, *grass root(s)* (← roots that split the earth in thrusting upward).
艸根也。从艸犮聲。春艸根枯，引之而發土爲撥，故謂之茇。一曰艸之白華爲茇。
茈艸也。从艸此聲。
As per 末# (minute) + 艸 grass/plant → *plant with numerous, minute flowers*. The compound 茉莉花 refers to a jasmine.
自急敕也。从羊省，从包省。从口，口猶愼言也。从羊，羊與義、善、美同意。凡茍之屬皆从茍。
艸也。从艸各聲。
As per 名# (reveal oneself) + 艸 grass/plant → *late-picked tea buds/leaves* (that reveal themselves after the original buds/leaves have been picked) → *tea plant*.
荼芽也。从艸名聲。
As per 西# (reddish color of the setting sun) + 艸 grass/plant → *madder* (plant, the roots of which produce red dye) → *madder red*. Compare 蒐.
茅蒐也。从艸西聲。
虈也。从艸𦣞聲。
艸也。从艸臣聲。
列# row + 艸 grass/plant → row of *rushes* → *rake* (made with rows of rushes or similar matter).
芀也。从艸𠛱聲。
As per 呉# (intersect) + 艸 grass/plant → a *species of grass resembling mugwort*, and used for weaving (compare 茣蓙 ゴザ rush mat).
缺盆也。从艸圭聲。
莿也。从艸朿聲。
As per 次# (align) + 艸 grass/plant → spiky projections aligned on the stalk of a plant (compare 朿) → *thorn* → *thatch/cover* (with rough materials); *thatched roof*.
以茅葦蓋屋。从艸次聲。
薢茩也。从艸后聲。

汒# is as per 亡 (obscure) + 水 water → vast spread of water, extending into obscurity → inundation. 茫 adds 艸 grass/plant → *vast*, grassy plain → *boundless* → *vague* (← only vaguely discernible on account of vastness).
艸皃。从艸在聲。濟北有茬平縣。
乾芻。从艸交聲。一曰牛蘄艸。
茮莍。从艸尗聲。
茱萸，茮屬。从艸朱聲。
艸# grass/plant + 幺 slender thread (doubled → slight) → luxuriant growth of slender vegetation → *luxuriant grasses*; *increase*. *This*, *here*, and *year* are borrowed meanings.
艸木多益。从艸，兹省聲。
As per 因# (superimpose) + 艸 grass/plant → *cushion*; *mattress* (← products made of layers of plant matter).
車重席。从艸因聲。
Variant of 荼 (plant with a bitter taste) applied to *tea* → *brown*; *tea ceremony*.
艸葉多。从艸伐聲。《春秋傳》曰：“晉糴茷。”
As per 耳# (supple) + 艸 grass/plant → soft, *luxuriant vegetation* → *mushroom*.
艸茸茸皃。从艸，聦省聲。
As per 如# (supple) + 艸 grass/plant → plant matter softened (by boiling or other means) → *boil*; *soften*; *soft*; *seethe*.
飤馬也。从艸如聲。
眾艸也。从四屮。凡茻之屬皆从茻。讀與冈同。
萹茿也。从艸，筑省聲。
艸也。从艸旬聲。
As per 全# (fully) + 艸 grass/plant → *aromatic plant* with a rich (= full) fragrance. *Fish trap* is a borrowed meaning, via 筌.
芥脃也。从艸全聲。
艸根也。从艸亥聲。
As per 合# (press/fit together) + 艸 grass/plant → beans pressed tightly between the sides of a shell/pod → *adzuki beans*.
小尗也。从艸合聲。
楚木也。从艸刑聲。
行# (straight and crossing) + 艸 grass/plant → Nymphoides peltata, also known as *yellow floating heart* (← water plant the stalk and flower of which cross at the waterline).
As per 早# (rising sun) + 艸 grass/plant → the rising sun as seen through plant life → *grass(es)* and *plants* → *rough*; *low-grade* → (rough style of) *handwriting*; *draft*.
草斗，櫟實也。一曰象斗子。从艸早聲。
刑# punishment + 艸 grass/plant → *thorn* plant from which a *whip* used in punishment is fashioned.
艸多葉皃。从艸而聲。沛城父有楊荋亭。
艸也。从艸安聲。
蚍𧉈也。从艸收聲。
荎藸，艸也。从艸至聲。
As per 任# (encompass) + 艸 grass/plant → *beans* encompassed in a pod → *soft* (← soft or softened pod).
桂荏，蘇。从艸任聲。
As per 存# (settle in place) + 艸 grass/plant → pile vegetation in a single spot to create a *mat* → *piled mats* → *repeat(edly)* (← pile on).
薦蓆也。从艸存聲。
As per 夷# (downward) + 艸 grass/plant → *bud/sprout* produced by a short plant. Echinochloa crus-galli, a type of wild grass, is a borrowed meaning via 稊.
艸也。从艸夷聲。

The lower element# is 亡 (obscure) + 川 river → watery wasteland (← obscure part of a river). 荒 adds 艸 grass/plant → *wasteland* → *wild*; *rough*; *lay waste to*; *devastate*; *go to ruin*; *vast*; *violence*; *riot*; *storm* → *chapping* (← roughness).
蕪也。从艸㠩聲。一曰艸淹地也。
馬帚也。从艸并聲。
艸也。似蒲而小，根可作㕞。从艸劦聲。
艸實。从艸夾聲。

entries.text: 艸也。从艸里聲。讀若釐。
豆# bean + 艸 grass/plant (for emphasis/clarification) → *bean*.
荵冬艸。从艸忍聲。
As per 何# (bear a load) + 艸 grass/plant → *lotus* (← plant borne on water). *Bear a load*, (a) *load*, *burden* and *undertake* are meanings applied after 何 was borrowed to express "what."
芙蕖葉。从艸何聲。
亂艸。从艸步聲。
茇也。茅根也。从艸均聲。
As per 狄# (disperse) + 艸 grass/plant → reeds/rushes dispersed over marshland → *reed*; *rush*. Compare 蒹.

As per 余# (stretch) + 艸 grass/plant → edible plant with a bitter taste, sometimes identified as Sonchus oleraceus. The function of 余 here is uncertain but may be connected to "stretch in relaxation" (compare 舍/舎), in the sense of a plant used to produce a relaxing drink. 荼 appears in transliterations of Sanskrit terms such as jhpeta (cremation: 荼毘) and mandala (曼荼羅).
苦荼也。从艸余聲。
兎葵也。从艸，稀省聲。
位# the crown/throne + 艸 grass/plant → crown or throne consisting (fully, or in part) of woven vegetation → *arrival, appearance or presence* of a person of high rank; *assume* (a high-ranking post).
萐莆也。从艸甫聲。
利# sharp + 艸 grass plant → plant with a sharp flavor when processed. The compound 茉莉花 refers to jasmine.
As per 壯# (tall and neat) + 艸 grass/plant → tall plant. *Solemnity*, *village*, *villa*, *store*, *shop* and *storage barn* are all borrowed meanings (for "storage barn," compare 藏 and 倉).
上諱。
越嶲縣名，見《史記》。从艸作聲。
茮樧實裏如表者。从艸求聲。
沙# sand + 艸 grass/plant → variety of *sedge* (← plant that grows in poor/sandy soil).
鎬侯也。从艸沙聲。
An abbreviated form# of 宮 (winding) + 艸 grass/plant → *taro*/*potato* with winding roots. Compare 芋.
齊謂芌爲莒。从艸呂聲。
貝母也。从艸，明省聲。
菨餘也。从艸杏聲。
As per 巠# as described in 徑 (extensive) + 艸 grass/plant → long *stalk*/*stem*.
枝柱也。从艸巠聲。

辛# bitter + 艸 grass/plant → plant with a sharp flavor (in Chinese, often specified as wild ginger) . *Long (and thin)* and *numerous* are associated meanings based on characteristics of the plant in question, such as long racemes and numerous plant hairs on the stem or elsewhere.
井藻也。从艸君聲。讀若威。
延# extend + 艸 grass/plant → extend vegetation in weaving mats → *grow thick* → *straw mat*.
莖也。从艸廷聲。
艸田器。从艸，條省聲。《論語》曰：“以杖荷莜。”今作蓧。
斬芻。从艸坐聲。

As per 完# (surround completely) + 艸 grass/plant → variety of reed (← plant that spreads in a circular manner about the main root; compare 葦) used in making (tatami) mats. *Smiling (manner)* is a borrowed meaning.
艸也。可以作席。从艸完聲。

As per 含# (contain) + 艸 grass/plant → *the full stem and spears of a rice plant about to blossom*; *bud* (compare 晗, which also features the idea of an object about to make its appearance). Compare also 稔 (grain contained in a husk).
As per 秀# (slender object curving upward) + 艸 grass/plant → slender *weed* resembling a rice plant → *something superficially good but in actuality bad* (← useless weed that resembles a grain crop).
禾粟下生莠。从艸秀聲。讀若酉。
As per 夾# (pressed between) + 艸 grass/plant → *shell/pod* (that sandwiches the bean contained inside).
杜榮也。从艸忘聲。
禮祭，束茅，加于祼圭，而灌鬯酒，是爲莤。象神歆之也。一曰莤，榼上塞也。从酉从艸。《春秋傳》曰：“尔貢包茅不入，王祭不供，無以莤酒。”
鹿藿之實名也。从艸狃聲。
惡艸皃。从艸肖聲。
As per 見# (fix upon) + 艸 grass/plant → species of *amaranthus* with bright yellow flowers (that capture one's attention) and edible leaves.
莧菜也。从艸見聲。
As per 良# (flowing stream) + 艸 grass/plant → a variety of *swampland plant* with long, flowing roots. *Tobacco* is a borrowed meaning in Japanese.
艸也。从艸良聲。
As per 孚# (envelop/enclose) + 艸 grass/plant → plant membrane enveloped within the stalk → *membrane of a reed* → *very thin*.
艸也。从艸孚聲。
As per 我# (bladed weapon → blade-like) + 艸 grass/plant → variety of *mugwort* with serrated leaves.
蘿莪，蒿屬。从艸我聲。

The relevant seal inscription form shows four sprouting plants + 日 sun/day → the setting sun, as seen from ground level, concealed by vegetation → *late*; *end*; *not be*; *must not*; *defy*; *disobey*; *refuse*; *decline*; *empty*; *vast*.
日且冥也。从日在茻中。
As per 來# (barley plant) + 艸 grass/plant → *weed* resembling a barley plant → *goosefoot*; *pigweed* → (fallow) *field overgrown with weeds*. Note a variant form 萊.

entries.text: Originally, a variant of 莫# (concealing vegetation), the 日 element replaced by 犬 dog/beast to suggest growth luxuriant enough to conceal a beast → *grassy plain*.
南昌謂犬善逐菟艸中爲莽。从犬从茻，茻亦聲。
茦也。从艸刺聲。
宛# bend + 艸 grass/plant → *luxuriant vegetation* drooping with its own weight.
茈菀，出漢中房陵。从艸宛聲。
靑/青# blue/green + 艸 grass/plant → *turnip* (with deep green leaves; compare the original sense of 青) → *flower of a variety of leek*; *flowery*.
韭華也。从艸青聲。
As per 官# (wrap about/enclose) + 艸 grass/plant → *sedge* (← vegetation woven into a raincoat wrapped about the body).
茅也。从艸官聲。
麻蒸也。从艸取聲。一曰蓐也。
彔 here an abbreviated form# of 綠 green + 艸 grass/plant → *green bamboo*; *Miscanthus tinctorius*.
王芻也。从艸录聲。《詩》曰：“菉竹猗猗。”
As per 匊# (wrap about) + 艸 grass/plant → flower of a wrap-about appearance → *chrysanthemum*.
大菊，蘧麥。从艸匊聲。
荎藸也。从艸味聲。
As per 囷# (round) + 艸 grass/plant → *fungus* (round growth that appears on vegetation) → *germ*.
地蕈也。从艸囷聲。
As per 昆# (circular group) + 艸 grass/plant → variety of *herb or aromatic grass* that grows in clumps (compare 萱 and 葷).
菏澤水。在山陽胡陵。《禹貢》：“浮于淮泗，達于菏。”从水苛聲。
瀆菐也。从丵从廾，廾亦聲。凡菐之屬皆从菐。
As per 甾# (cut weeds in a field) + 艸 grass/plant → field barren of both weeds and crops → *wasteland* → *disaster*; *calamity* (compare 災). 菑 was devised to replace 甾 after 甾 came to refer to "evil."
不耕田也。从艸、甾。《易》曰：“不菑畬。”
果# fruit + 艸 grass/plant → *fruit* → *confection*. 菓 was devised to replace 果 when the latter came to refer primarily to results and related abstract meanings.

As per 服# (spread over) + 艸 grass/plant → large variety of turnip or *radish* (← vegetable with roots that spread/crawl over the earth). 菔 and 蔔 are effectively variant forms corresponding to the same term.
蘆菔。似蕪菁，實如小尗者。从艸服聲。
昌# bright + 艸 grass/plant → *iris* (← flower with bright petals).
采# pluck + 艸 grass/plant → pluck/pick *greens*/*vegetables* → *rape* (plant); *side dish*; *cuisine*.
艸之可食者。从艸采聲。
As per 兔#/兎 rabbit (fast-moving) + 艸 grass/plant → rapidly growing vine; *dodder* ( 菟糸: a parasitic vine that extends rapidly toward a host plant). Note a variant form 莵.
艸 grass/plant + 波# for the sound alone to transliterate the first syllable of the Northern Indian term palak (spinach: 菠薐).
香蒿也。从艸臤聲。
菜，類蒿。从艸近聲。《周禮》有“菦菹”。
菨餘也。从艸妾聲。

艸 grass/plant + 咅# (spread) → a plant with a widely spreading fragrance (compare 芳 and 苾). 菩 eventually came to be used for transliterations of Sanskrit-language Buddhist terms such as 菩薩 for bodhisattva (roughly, one who helps sentient beings attain Buddhahood).
艸也。从艸咅聲。
A variant form of 𦰩# as described in 漢 (minute) + 艸 grass/plant → minute/small flowering plant → a *violet*.
艸也。从艸沼聲。
水衣。从艸治聲。

The relevant seal inscription form is as per 于# (U-shaped) + an element combining 垂 hang (doubled) and 艸 grass/plant → beautiful *flower*, the center of which sinks in a U-shape → *gorgeous* (← beautiful). Also, *brilliant* (← brilliant coloring, or brilliant beauty) and *China* (← country likened to a beautiful flower).
榮也。从艸从𠌶。凡華之屬皆从華。
As per 弧# (pendent) + 艸 grass/plant → pendent, flowering heads of *wild rice* hanging above the waterline.

As per 夌# as described in 陵 (stretch) + 艸 grass/plant → *water caltrop* (the fruit of which has long, well-defined lines). (Water caltrop also goes by the name of water chestnut, but it is the corms of a different plant, Eleocharis dulcis, that feature in Chinese cuisine.) *Diamond-shaped* is via the compound 菱形.

非# (spread in alignment to right and left) + 艸 grass/plant → a reddish *vegetable* with roots spreading from right to left. Also, *thin* and *slight* (← slender vegetable) → *reduce*; *economize* (← make do with poor stuff such as turnip-like vegetables) and *luxuriant vegetation* (← vegetables growing to right and left).
芴也。从艸非聲。
黃菳也。从艸金聲。
奄# cover/conceal + 艸 grass/plant → *thatched structure*. 菴 is effectively a variant form of 庵 hermitage.
艸盛。从艸奉聲。
鬱也。从艸於聲。一曰𣨙也。
As per 苴# (plant matter) + 水 water → *vegetation at water's edge*. *Pickled vegetables* (compare 漬) is via reinterpretation of the constituent elements of this character.
酢菜也。从艸沮聲。
蒿屬。从艸林聲。
As per 叔# (bean vine) + 艸 grass/plant → (generic term for) *beans* and *peas*.
艸木倒。从艸到聲。
